title: MaleTheme Duo #025 · 남 클래식 머슬·블랙 스모키 윙·서퍼 테마 / 남 피트니스 모델·실버 포일·검투사 테마
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunlit open-air stone terrace at midday with a pale paved floor, a waist-high balustrade, potted palms and a standard-height doorway, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Russian man in his early 30s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful boy-group center idol face with neat sharp brows, a slim nose and glossy full lips, clean-shaven, dramatic black smoky eyeshadow with sharp winged eyeliner, pale smooth skin with a cool undertone, a calm gentle gaze, soft pastel-peach hair styled in half-up, top section lifted with the length flowing loose below, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large gold hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a silver hammer head, a lead chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a silver square-sided cowbell, an iron ship's anchor), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked gold rings. Extremely long round nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful, classically muscular man, far beyond any real person, in the shape of a Greek statue. Wide shoulders, a full defined chest, a clean six-pack abdomen, strong rounded arms, and muscular thighs and calves, balanced and proportionate from head to toe, powerful and enormous. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a shark-tooth necklace and a minimal neon-orange T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, soaked and clinging, water streaming down his whole body in glistening rivulets with countless droplets clinging to his skin, his hair soaking wet and slicked.
LEFT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme olive-green chunky platform boots with thick platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary sole.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Norwegian man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a fresh-faced boy-group idol face with clear glowing skin, bright eyes and a gentle smile line, clean-shaven, silver foil-lined eyes with a cool shimmer, pale smooth skin with a soft pink undertone, a bright open smile showing his teeth, cool ash-grey hair styled in a short pixie cut, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long silver chain ending in one large faceted ruby drop, and on the other ear a large gold hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a lead ship's anchor, a gold chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three platinum bracelets. Extremely long square nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: A tall, extraordinarily well-built athletic man, far beyond any real person in size, built like a fitness model. Broad shoulders, a full athletic chest, a lean defined abdomen with a clear eight-pack, strong toned arms, a narrow waist, and long strong toned legs with defined calves. Large and powerful in frame, yet taut, lean and elegant rather than bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a polished bronze gladiator helmet with a tall red crest, criss-crossing thin leather straps with bronze studs over his bare chest, bronze arm bracers, and a minimal bronze-studded brown leather T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his stomach bare.
RIGHT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme black needle heels with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
